title: Boundless Bio to Participate in the 2024 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference
description: Boundless Bio, a clinical-stage oncology company, announced that its executives will participate in the 2024 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference. The company is developing therapies targeting extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) to treat oncogene amplified cancers.
